Music recipes · Drone plus a melody played by the reverb

The singing reverb

The synth holds one note. The reverb plays the melody: its built-in eight-step sequencer retunes the cloud in a pentatonic scale, gliding from note to note.

Level MediumSetup 15 minKey A, major pentatonic

  1. OXI One MK2sequencer
  2. PERfourMER MKIIsynth
  3. Grand Canyondelay
  4. NightSkyreverb
  1. What you'll hear
  2. 1. PERfourMER: a long drone
  3. 2. Grand Canyon: a warm analog-style echo
  4. 3. NightSky: set up the sound

What you'll hear

A warm, unchanging drone. Above it, the reverb itself sings a slow, gliding melody, always in key, because the NightSky snaps each step to a scale.

The trick: the NightSky has an eight-step sequencer for its SIZE/PITCH knob. Freeze a note, and each step retunes the frozen cloud.

1. PERfourMER: a long drone

Synth channel 1 on MIDI channel 1; channels 3 and 4 VOLUME down.

  • WAVEsinetrianglesquaresawnoiseEXTPlenty of harmonics for the reverb to work with.
  • OCTAVE16'Low and full.
  • CUTOFF10 o'clockDark.
  • RESONANCE10 o'clockA little glow.
  • Filter LFO INT9 o'clockSlow movement in the drone.
  • LFO WAVES&Hsinesaw or squareSmooth.
  • LFO SPEED/PHASE8 o'clockVery slow.
  • VCA MODEEGGATEONAlways on: a true drone that never re-swells when the OXI loops. Turn VOLUME down to stop it.
  • PANnoonIn the main left output, which feeds the pedals.

2. Grand Canyon: a warm analog-style echo

  • DELAY TYPEDMMThe Deluxe Memory Man emulation: dark, warm repeats.
  • MOD RATE (left mini knob)noonThe manual says noon matches the original's chorus setting.
  • MOD DEPTH (right mini knob)10 o'clockGentle chorus.
  • DELAYnoonMedium.
  • FEEDBACK10 o'clockA few repeats.
  • DELAY LVL11 o'clockUnder the drone.

3. NightSky: set up the sound

  • TEXTUREsparsedensediffuseDense: the pitch steps stay clear.
  • LENGTH3 o'clockVery long.
  • QUANTIZEsmoothhalf stepscaleEvery step snaps to a scale.
  • ScaleHold QUANTIZE and press PRESET button 2Major pentatonic (it's also the factory setting). Button 1 is minor pentatonic.
  • FILTERregenlow passDarkens as it decays.
  • HIGH CUTnoonSoft.
  • LOW CUT9 o'clockBarely.
  • SHIMMER (knob)minOff: the sequence is the movement.
  • DEPTHminNo modulation.
  • DRYnoonUnity.
  • REVERB2 o'clockThe singing cloud should be loud.

4. The OXI One: start the drone

  1. Tempo around 60 BPM.
  2. Sequencer 1 (Mono, Ch 1): an A on step 1, tied across all 16 steps. With VCA MODE on ON, the drone sounds continuously at that pitch.
  3. Leave the bass out: the drone is enough.

5. NightSky: program the melody

  1. Keep the drone running (step 4) so there's sound in the reverb while you program: the manual's tip.
  2. Hold the INFINITE footswitch until the ON LED turns red: you're in Sequence mode. The 8 PRESET buttons are now the 8 steps.
  3. Press PRESET buttons 1 to 5 so they light amber: five active steps. An unlit step is skipped, not a rest.
  4. For each step: hold its PRESET button and turn SIZE/PITCH to pick its note. Counter-clockwise is higher.
  5. Add glide: hold SHAPE and turn REVERB to about 11 o'clock. Steps now slide into each other.
  6. Run it: tap the FAVORITE footswitch on the beat a few times. It plays at that tempo; each step can be up to 2 seconds.
  7. Stop: press the ON footswitch once (it returns to step 1). To leave Sequence mode, hold INFINITE again.

You got it right when

  • The drone never stops or re-swells.
  • The reverb moves between pitches in a loop, gliding, while the drone stays put.

6. The performance

  • Change the scale: leave Sequence mode (hold INFINITE), hold QUANTIZE and press PRESET 1 for minor pentatonic, then re-enter. The same melody turns sad. (In Sequence mode the PRESET buttons are the steps.)

If it sounds wrong

  • The sequence won't run: at least two steps must be active (lit amber).
  • Steps sound out of key: QUANTIZE isn't on scale.
  • The melody is too fast: tap FAVORITE more slowly.

Sources

  • NightSky manual: Sequence mode, programming steps, glide and tempo (pp. 21–24), QUANTIZE and scales (pp. 6–7), factory scale (p. 41).
  • Grand Canyon manual: DMM, "The noon setting is equivalent to a DMM's chorus setting" (p. 18).
  • PERfourMER MKII manual: LFO (p. 16), envelope (p. 20).
  • OXI One MKII manual: ties (p. 55).
